name: slide-toggle
gotchas: As of Angular Material 15+, `mat-slide-toggle` no longer wraps a native `<input type="checkbox">` inside the same host the way older versions did — form directives (`formControlName`, `[(ngModel)]`) still work, but code that queried for a nested `<input>` (e.g. in tests) needs updating.
`(change)` fires only for direct user toggling, not for programmatic changes to the bound value — don't rely on it to react to code-driven state changes the way you would with a plain event listener.

`required` on a standalone (non-form) slide toggle has no built-in validation effect — it only participates in Angular Forms validation when used with `formControlName`/`[(ngModel)]` inside a `<form>`.
